_status: INCOMPLETE AND NOT LAUNCH-READY. This file holds only the ten dishes confirmed in CLIENT_FACTS.md, at brand-level prices. It is NOT the per-location menu. SITE_ARCHITECTURE.md Open Decision #12: we do not know what each location actually serves, Toast is the seed source, and /menu/ cannot ship until that pull happens.
_availabilityStatus: STUBBED. The `locations` array is the per-location availability column described in SITE_ARCHITECTURE.md. It is deliberately empty on every row because we do not have the data. Templates must not render per-location availability while this is empty, and Menu schema must not be emitted per location. College Heights (pared-down ramen bar), Plaza Bonita (quick-serve, no alcohol), and Maui (own dishes) genuinely differ.
_descriptionStatus: DRAFT, PENDING CLIENT APPROVAL. Descriptions are ingredient lists carried over from the design concept, with unconfirmed claims removed (the concept's 'simmered twelve hours' has no source in CLIENT_FACTS.md and is not repeated here). No description asserts anything about flour, hydration, water, alkalinity, aging, or noodle cadence. Amanda must sign these off before launch.
_priceStatus: Brand-level prices from the Client DNA. CLIENT_FACTS.md says prices drift and must be treated as CONFIRM before shipping schema `offers`. No `offers` are emitted anywhere yet.
_carnitasNote: Carnitas Ramen is deliberately absent. It is a real dish at all six SD locations and was the most-reviewed ramen in the 2025 sample, but SITE_ARCHITECTURE.md Open Decision #4 is unresolved. The recommendation is to list it plainly with `feature: no` once Sam confirms. Do not add it with `feature: yes` under any circumstance, and do not add it to a hero, card, or photo slot.
